Chapter 8.2, Automatic Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products, First Edition. April 1983 (ANSI/ASTM D 4177)

This chapter covers automatic procedures for obtaining representative samples of petroleum and nonuniform stocks or shipments, except electrical insulating oils. 32 pages.

Price each, $6.00

Chapter 9, Density Determination This chapter describes the standard methods and apparatus used to determine the specific gravity of crude petroleum products normally handled as liquids. It is divided into subchapters as follows.
